h1: Senior product leadership. Still close to the work.
hero.sub: A fractional CPO gives a scale-up senior product leadership without forcing a full-time hire before the role makes commercial sense. The job is to create direction, improve decisions, help the team deliver and stay accountable for what the product is trying to change.

diagram.caption: LEADERSHIP + DELIVERY
diagram.sub: The product decision stays connected to the work.

sections.heading: What Is a Fractional CPO?
intro: A fractional CPO is a senior product leader who works with a business on a part-time or fractional basis, taking ownership of product direction without joining as a full-time executive.

For a scale-up, that can bridge the gap between founder-led product decisions and a permanent product leadership hire. The useful version of the role stays close enough to customers, data and delivery to make informed decisions rather than operating only at board level.

sections.heading: When a Fractional CPO Is the Right Move

items.title: Founder-led product is reaching its limit
items.body: Product decisions still depend on the founder, but the company now needs a repeatable product operating model.

items.title: There is a leadership gap
items.body: A CPO or product leader has left, or the business needs senior ownership before making the next permanent hire.

items.title: The product team needs direction
items.body: Delivery capability exists, but strategy, prioritisation and decision rights are unclear.

items.title: The next stage needs senior product judgement
items.body: The business is entering a new market, changing proposition, preparing to scale or making a material product investment.

sections.heading: Fractional CPO Services From Strategy Through Delivery

items.title: Product strategy
items.body: Clarify customer problems, strategic bets and how product choices connect to business outcomes.

items.title: Roadmap and prioritisation
items.body: Create a defensible approach to what moves forward and what does not.

items.title: Team and operating model
items.body: Clarify roles, decision rights, discovery practices and the connection between product, design, engineering and GTM.

items.title: Hands-on product work
items.body: Step into discovery, user journeys, prototypes, requirements and delivery detail when the situation needs it.

items.title: Leadership communication
items.body: Turn product evidence and trade-offs into clear updates for founders, leadership teams and boards.

items.q: What does a fractional CPO do?
items.a: A fractional CPO provides senior product leadership on a part-time basis. The role can cover product strategy, [customer discovery](/product-strategy/discovery), roadmap and prioritisation, team development, delivery oversight and leadership reporting. At Commview, the role stays hands-on where useful, so strategic decisions remain connected to what customers and delivery teams are actually showing.

items.q: What does a fractional CPO cost?
items.a: Fractional CPO cost depends on the scope, level of ownership, time commitment and whether the engagement includes hands-on delivery as well as leadership. Commview does not publish a standard rate because those requirements vary significantly. We define the product problem, expected responsibility and working cadence before agreeing the commercial structure.

sections.heading: You may need CPO-level decisions before you need a full-time CPO.
sections.body: Bring senior product leadership into the business without separating strategy from delivery.
